O.location: leftmost plotted point at the 2005 x-axis tick
rightmost plotted point at the 2015 x-axis tick

O.content: No printed substantial-change threshold or routing instruction is visible.

B.text: If substantial-change follow-up requires meeting an explicit numeric threshold or other stated criterion, and none is supplied in the chart or task materials, the chart alone does not establish eligibility; if the workflow defaults unverified changes to routine monitoring, select routine monitoring.
B.conditions: Applies only under a strict threshold-required interpretation with a routine-monitoring default; neither is explicitly supplied.

O.location: leftmost plotted point at the 2005 x-axis tick
rightmost plotted point at the 2015 x-axis tick

O.content: The title reads "District Heating Demand Index"; the horizontal axis is labeled "Year" and the vertical axis is labeled "Demand index".

B.text: If the plotted series titled "District Heating Demand Index" binds each year tick to its adjacent printed point label, the 2005-to-2015 full-period change is the 2015 labeled value minus the 2005 labeled value. If an approximately 14.0°C absolute change is treated as substantial for the routing criterion, select substantial-change follow-up.
B.conditions: Assumes the printed endpoint labels are the relevant demand-index values and that a 14.0°C full-period change qualifies as substantial; no numeric substantial-change threshold is displayed.
